# BAM FILES MANAGEMENT
```{bash}
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ============================================================
# DYS ChIP-seq Pipeline, Drosophila melanogaster (dm6)
# Transcription factor: Dysfusion (Dys), bHLH-PAS activator
# Heterodimer partner: Tango (Tgo), analysed in Chapter 3
# Replicates: PAIRED-END throughout (3 biological replicates + 1 matched input control)
# IDR strategy: pairwise (1v2, 1v3, 2v3); consensus = peaks in >=2/3 pairs
# ============================================================

set -euo pipefail

# ============================================================
# DIRECTORY STRUCTURE
# ============================================================
# 01_fastqc/dys/ raw FASTQ; 03_bam/ BAM; 04_qc/ dup metrics, insert sizes, fingerprint
# 07_blacklist/ filtered BAMs; 08_qc/ correlation matrices
# 09_peaks/ per-replicate MACS3 peaks; 10_idr/ pairwise IDR; 11_final/ final peak set
# 12_pseudoreps/ not used, PE with 3 reps

mkdir -p 03_bam 04_qc 07_blacklist 08_qc 09_peaks 10_idr 11_final
mkdir -p $PROJECT_DIR/tmp


# ============================================================
# STAGE 1, ALIGNMENT (SAM -> BAM -> SORT)
# Bowtie2 PE alignment of replicate FASTQs, run once per replicate (R1/R2 pair),
# producing SAM files in 03_bam/:
# ============================================================
bowtie2 -x dm6 \
   -1 01_fastqc/dys/ENCFF850GFV.fastq.gz \
   -2 01_fastqc/dys/ENCFF038CZD.fastq.gz \
   -S 03_bam/DYS_rep1.sam -p 8
#
 bowtie2 -x dm6 \
   -1 01_fastqc/dys/ENCFF043NYJ.fastq.gz \
   -2 01_fastqc/dys/ENCFF362XNT.fastq.gz \
   -S 03_bam/DYS_rep2.sam -p 8
#
 bowtie2 -x dm6 \
   -1 01_fastqc/dys/ENCFF207TJL.fastq.gz \
   -2 01_fastqc/dys/ENCFF027UZF.fastq.gz \
   -S 03_bam/DYS_rep3.sam -p 8

for REP in 1 2 3
do
  samtools view -bS 03_bam/DYS_rep${REP}.sam \
    | samtools sort -o 03_bam/DYS_rep${REP}.bam
done

# Remove SAM files to recover disk space
rm 03_bam/DYS_rep*.sam


# ============================================================
# STAGE 2, ADD READ GROUPS
# ============================================================

picard -Djava.io.tmpdir=$PROJECT_DIR/tmp \
AddOrReplaceReadGroups \
  I=03_bam/DYS_rep1.bam \
  O=03_bam/DYS_rep1.RG.bam \
  RGID=DYS_rep1 RGLB=lib1 RGPL=ILLUMINA RGPU=unit1 RGSM=DYS_rep1

picard -Djava.io.tmpdir=$PROJECT_DIR/tmp \
AddOrReplaceReadGroups \
  I=03_bam/DYS_rep2.bam \
  O=03_bam/DYS_rep2.RG.bam \
  RGID=DYS_rep2 RGLB=lib1 RGPL=ILLUMINA RGPU=unit2 RGSM=DYS_rep2

picard -Djava.io.tmpdir=$PROJECT_DIR/tmp \
AddOrReplaceReadGroups \
  I=03_bam/DYS_rep3.bam \
  O=03_bam/DYS_rep3.RG.bam \
  RGID=DYS_rep3 RGLB=lib1 RGPL=ILLUMINA RGPU=unit3 RGSM=DYS_rep3


# ============================================================
# STAGE 3, SORT AFTER READ GROUPS
# ============================================================

for REP in 1 2 3
do
  samtools sort -@ 8 \
    -o 03_bam/DYS_rep${REP}.RG.sorted.bam \
    03_bam/DYS_rep${REP}.RG.bam
done


# ============================================================
# STAGE 4, MARK AND REMOVE DUPLICATES
# ============================================================

for REP in 1 2 3
do
picard -Djava.io.tmpdir=$PROJECT_DIR/tmp \
  MarkDuplicates \
    I=03_bam/DYS_rep${REP}.RG.sorted.bam \
    O=03_bam/DYS_rep${REP}.rmdup.bam \
    M=04_qc/DYS_rep${REP}.dup_metrics.txt \
    REMOVE_DUPLICATES=true \
    ASSUME_SORTED=true
done
#TMP_DIR=$PROJECT_DIR/tmp


# ============================================================
# STAGE 5, FILTER BAM
# -q 30  : MAPQ >= 30
# -f 2   : properly paired reads only (PE-specific)
# -F 1804: exclude unmapped, mate unmapped, not primary, supplementary, duplicate
# ============================================================

for REP in 1 2 3
do
  samtools view -b \
    -q 30 \
    -f 2 \
    -F 1804 \
    03_bam/DYS_rep${REP}.rmdup.bam \
    > 03_bam/DYS_rep${REP}.filtered.bam

  samtools index 03_bam/DYS_rep${REP}.filtered.bam
done


# ============================================================
# STAGE 6, BLACKLIST REMOVAL (all replicates use filtered.bam)
# ============================================================

for REP in 1 2 3
do
  bedtools intersect -v \
    -a 03_bam/DYS_rep${REP}.filtered.bam \
    -b dm6-blacklist.v2.bed \
    > 07_blacklist/DYS_rep${REP}.clean.bam

  samtools index 07_blacklist/DYS_rep${REP}.clean.bam
done


# ============================================================
# STAGE 7, CONTROL PROCESSING (paired-end)
# Input control: ENCFF063EMW (R1), ENCFF833TRM (R2)
# ============================================================

bowtie2 -x dm6 \
  -1 01_fastqc/dys/ENCFF063EMW.fastq.gz \
  -2 01_fastqc/dys/ENCFF833TRM.fastq.gz \
  -S 03_bam/DYS_control.sam -p 8

samtools view -bS 03_bam/DYS_control.sam | samtools sort -o 03_bam/DYS_control.sorted.bam

rm 03_bam/DYS_control.sam

picard -Djava.io.tmpdir=$PROJECT_DIR/tmp \
AddOrReplaceReadGroups \
  I=03_bam/DYS_control.sorted.bam \
  O=03_bam/DYS_control.RG.bam \
  RGID=DYS_ctrl RGLB=lib1 RGPL=ILLUMINA RGPU=unit1 RGSM=DYS_ctrl

picard -Djava.io.tmpdir=$PROJECT_DIR/tmp \
MarkDuplicates \
  I=03_bam/DYS_control.RG.bam \
  O=03_bam/DYS_control.rmdup.bam \
  M=04_qc/DYS_control.dup_metrics.txt \
  REMOVE_DUPLICATES=true \
  ASSUME_SORTED=true

samtools view -b -q 30 -f 2 -F 1804 \
  03_bam/DYS_control.rmdup.bam \
  > 03_bam/DYS_control.filtered.bam

bedtools intersect -v \
  -a 03_bam/DYS_control.filtered.bam \
  -b dm6-blacklist.v2.bed \
  > 07_blacklist/DYS_control.clean.bam

samtools index 07_blacklist/DYS_control.clean.bam


# ============================================================
# STAGE 8, MERGE REPLICATES INTO POOLED BAM (for signal assignment later)
# ============================================================

samtools merge -f 07_blacklist/DYS_merged.clean.bam \
  07_blacklist/DYS_rep1.clean.bam \
  07_blacklist/DYS_rep2.clean.bam \
  07_blacklist/DYS_rep3.clean.bam

samtools index 07_blacklist/DYS_merged.clean.bam


# ============================================================
# STAGE 9, QC BEFORE PEAK CALLING
# (Peak calling itself is in threshold_comparison_dys.sh and production_peaks_dys.sh)
# ============================================================

# Step 1: flagstat to confirm depth
samtools flagstat 07_blacklist/DYS_rep1.clean.bam
samtools flagstat 07_blacklist/DYS_rep2.clean.bam
samtools flagstat 07_blacklist/DYS_rep3.clean.bam
samtools flagstat 07_blacklist/DYS_control.clean.bam

# Step 2: fragment size QC (paired-end, actual insert sizes from TLEN)
mkdir -p 04_qc/insert_sizes

bamPEFragmentSize \
  -b 07_blacklist/DYS_rep1.clean.bam \
     07_blacklist/DYS_rep2.clean.bam \
     07_blacklist/DYS_rep3.clean.bam \
     07_blacklist/DYS_control.clean.bam \
  --samplesLabel "DYS_rep1" "DYS_rep2" "DYS_rep3" "DYS_control" \
  --histogram 04_qc/insert_sizes/DYS_insert_size_histogram.png \
  --outRawFragmentLengths 04_qc/insert_sizes/DYS_insert_sizes.tab \
  -p 8
```

```{bash}
# Step 3: fingerprint (cumulative enrichment plot)
mkdir -p 04_qc/fingerprint

plotFingerprint \
  -b 07_blacklist/DYS_rep1.clean.bam \
     07_blacklist/DYS_rep2.clean.bam \
     07_blacklist/DYS_rep3.clean.bam \
     07_blacklist/DYS_control.clean.bam \
  --plotFile 04_qc/fingerprint/DYS_fingerprint.png \
  --outRawCounts 04_qc/fingerprint/DYS_fingerprint.tab \
  --numberOfSamples 500000 \
  -p 8

# Step 4: replicate correlation (Spearman on binned coverage)
multiBamSummary bins \
  -b 07_blacklist/DYS_rep1.clean.bam \
     07_blacklist/DYS_rep2.clean.bam \
     07_blacklist/DYS_rep3.clean.bam \
  --labels DYS_rep1 DYS_rep2 DYS_rep3 \
  -o 08_qc/DYS.npz \
  -p 8

plotCorrelation \
  -in 08_qc/DYS.npz \
  --corMethod spearman \
  --skipZeros \
  --colorMap RdYlBu \
  --whatToPlot heatmap \
  --plotFile 08_qc/DYS_spearman_heatmap.pdf \
  --outFileCorMatrix 08_qc/DYS_spearman_matrix.txt

plotCorrelation \
  -in 08_qc/DYS.npz \
  --corMethod spearman \
  --whatToPlot scatterplot \
  --plotFile 08_qc/DYS_spearman_scatter.pdf

# Spearman interpretation: >= 0.8 good, 0.6-0.8 moderate, < 0.6 problematic
# === END OF UPSTREAM PIPELINE ===
# Next step: threshold_comparison_dys.sh to select the optimal MACS3 p-value
# Then:    production_peaks_dys.sh to call peaks, run pairwise IDR, and build consensus
```
